question: Is Amazon Web Services an empanelled cloud service provider for Maharashtra government departments?
gold_answer: Not any more. It was empanelled as a Tier-1 provider from 01-05-2018 to 30-04-2021 (circulars of 19-05-2018 and 04-08-2018), but the empanelment ended on 30-04-2021 and departments were told to buy cloud services through GeM (23-04-2021)

product.answer: Yes, Amazon Web Services is listed as a Tier-1 empanelled Cloud Service Provider (CSP) in the GR dated 19-05-2018, under the name Amazon Web Services (AISPL). Tier-1 empanelment for Amazon Web Services (AISPL) is valid for the period from 1.5.2018 till 30.4.2021.
